s: Din birkat perot haaretz, ubo z' seipim: al perot haaretz mebarekin "bore peri haadama". Vesiman leda ezeh peri haetz veezeh peri haadama: kol sheillu yinnatel happeri venishar heanap qayyam leshana habbaa umotzi happeri — hare zeh peri haetz. Abal kol shekkalu etzayv legamre bachorep vechozerim vetzomechim mishsharashayv — en perotayv chashubim peri haetz, umebarekin alehem "bore peri haadama". Lepikak, mebarekin al tutim haggedelim bisneh "bore peri haadama":

Bammeh debarim amurim? Betutim, shehem tobim laakila uperi gamur hen, ella sheen heanap mitqayyem mishshana lachabertah, abal mine perot geruim haggedelim beilane seraq, kegon tappuchim qetannim veaggasim qetannim haggedelim bayyaar, veken innebe hahadas, ap al pi shehem reuyim laakila — enam chashubim peri, veen mebarekin alehem ella "shehakkol nihya bidbaro", ben chayyim ben mebushshalim. Abal egozim qetannim haggedelim bayyaar — perot chashubim hem, umebarekin alehem "bore peri haetz". Veken peri sheqqorin brvmbary"n, uperi adom sheqqorin arpvr"t. Veken otam sheqqorin yagyda"s hashshechorim. Abal haadummim gedelim baeseb, ubirkatam "bore peri haadama":

Otan tutim adummim hannimtzaim betammuz, (vegam) yesh (min) hannimtzaim bachorep, veen bahem ella sarap lebad kanus betok hachartzannim, umotzetzim otan vezoreqin otan — mebarekin alehem "shehakkol" keal shear me perot. Veap im bolean im haqqelippa vehaggarin, mikkol maqom, enenu root shehaqqelippa vehaggarin en reuyim laakila, im ken en lebarek ella al hammashqeh shebbetokah:

Zangebil beodo ratob shehu rauy laakila — mebarekim alayv "bore peri haadama" velo "bore peri haetz", lepi sheeno iqqar happeri, ki hu shoresh tachat haqqarqa. Veken al shoresh sheqqorin laqry"tz im boleo:

Veken zangebil yabesh sheasa mimmennu mirqachat — mebarekim alayv "bore peri haadama". Veken pilpelim yebeshim, sheap shennaasu reuyim laakila al yede haddebash — en haddebash chashub iqqar ella tapel, shehare hu ba lehakshiram uletaqqenam. Veken besamim shechuqim umeorabim im tzuqe"r, kemo shergilim liktosh zangebil yabesh uleorbo im tzuqe"r (sheqqorin magy"n pvlvva"r), ap sheenan reuyim laakila kelal bipne atzman — en hatztzuqe"r chashub iqqar ella tapel, shehu ba lehakshiram uletaqqenam:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemine besamim vetablin, sheddarkan leheakel al yede tiggun bidbash, o al yede taarobet tzuqe"r o dabar acher, beinyan shehem chashubim iqqar, kegon zangebil upilpelin vetzipporen vekayyotze bahem. Abal mine besamim vetablin sheen darkan leheakel ella keshemmetabbelin bahem hattabshil, veaz hattabshil hu iqqar, veen haakila niqret al shem hattablin kelal, ukeillu enan omedin laakila kelal, kegon tzytvva"r vekayyotze bo — en shem peri alayv kelal. Veap im tiqqeno vehikshiro laakila kemot shehu, kemo shergilin shetztzolin tzytvva"r veokelin lirpua — en mebarekin alayv ella "shehakkol", kevan sheen notein oto al daat leoklo kelal, ella al daat litten battabshil. Veen tzarik lomar im tiggeno bidbash o sheerebo im tzuqe"r. Abal keshetztzolin zangebi"l lirpua — mebarekin alayv "bore peri haadama", kevan shennaasa rauy laakila al yede zeh:
